response.text: The `tpl_cli` repository provides a python-based command-line interface skeleton. Its primary entry point is `cli.py::main`, which processes command-line arguments passed via `argv`, executes a single subcommand, and outputs an exit code. The project structure consists of a single module, defined in `cli.py`, alongside a single test file to verify the tool's functionality.
